description: County-level PV installation area dataset of China (2010–2022) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Qian Du, aolin Lai (Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics(NUAA)). This dataset provides county-level photovoltaic (PV) installation area estimates for 1,593 counties in China, covering the period 2010–2022. It was derived from the vectorized PV polygon dataset of Chen et al. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
